constraints.name: account_role_audit_action_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((action_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ROLE_GRANTED'::character varying, 'ROLE_REVOKED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (actor_account_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((previous_role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Learner'::character varying, 'Administrator'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((new_role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Learner'::character varying, 'Administrator'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((previous_role)::text <> (new_role)::text)) OR (((action_type)::text = 'ROLE_MANAGER_BOOTSTRAPPED'::text) AND (actor_account_id IS NULL) AND (previous_role IS NULL) AND (new_role IS NULL))))

constraints.name: ai_stage_run_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((recovery_of_run_id IS NULL) AND (recovery_authorized_by IS NULL) AND (recovery_reason IS NULL)) OR ((recovery_of_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (recovery_authorized_by IS NOT NULL) AND (recovery_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim((recovery_reason)::text)) >= 20))))

constraints.name: ai_stage_run_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((stage)::text = 'AI1'::text) AND (predecessor_validation_id IS NULL)) OR (((stage)::text = 'AI2'::text) AND (predecessor_validation_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ai_stage_run_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'PROCESSING'::character varying, 'RETRY_WAIT'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: assessment_blueprint_counts_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((max_questions > 0) AND (target_mcq >= 0) AND (target_sql >= 0) AND (target_essay >= 0) AND (((target_mcq + target_sql) + target_essay) = max_questions)))

constraints.name: session_release_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((result_release_policy)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['IMMEDIATE'::character varying, 'HUMAN_VERIFIED'::character varying])::text[])) AND (review_revision >= 0) AND ((release_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['unsubmitted'::character varying, 'auto_grading'::character varying, 'provisional_ai'::character varying, 'pending_review'::character varying, 'reviewed'::character varying, 'published'::character varying, 'grading_failed'::character varying])::text[]))))

constraints.name: tag_review_check
